name: MACS J0003.1-0605 (Hubble)
blurb: MACS J0003.1-0605, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: macsj0003-hubble
story: A massive cluster of galaxies, caught in a quick Hubble snapshot from a survey of extreme clusters that earlier searches had let slip away.

claims.text: MACSJ0003.1-0605 is a target of Hubble program 16670, a SNAPshot survey of extreme (massive) galaxy clusters
The 'They almost got away' program searches for massive clusters missed by earlier surveys
